theorem inf_comap_le_comap_add (f₁ f₂ : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂) :
    comap f₁ q ⊓ comap f₂ q ≤ comap (f₁ + f₂) q := by

  simpa [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.add_apply] using q.add_mem hm₁ hm₂

candidates.claim: In `ContinuousLinearEquiv.submoduleMap`, `continuous_invFun` is proved via `(map_continuous e.symm).restrict` with a manual proof-term extracting the subtype property from `LinearEquiv.submoduleMap ...`. This is more complicated than necessary and obscures that the inverse is a `codRestrict` of a continuous map, just like `continuous_toFun`.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
def submoduleMap (e : M ≃SL[σ₁₂] M₂) (p : Submodule R M) :
    p ≃SL[σ₁₂] Submodule.map (e : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) p where
  __ := LinearEquiv.submoduleMap e.toLinearEquiv p
  continuous_toFun := map_continuous ((e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp p.subtypeL).codRestrict _ _)
  continuous_invFun :=
    map_continuous
      ((e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
            (Submodule.map (e : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) p).subtypeL).codRestrict _ _)

candidates.requested_change: Rewrite `continuous_invFun` to use `map_continuous` on an explicit `codRestrict` expression for the inverse, mirroring the `continuous_toFun` proof, instead of using `.restrict` and a manual membership proof.
candidates.suggested_fix:
Use
`continuous_invFun := map_continuous ((e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (Submodule.map (e : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) p).subtypeL).codRestrict _ _)`.
This compiles as a drop-in replacement.

candidates.claim: In `ContinuousLinearMap.iInfKerProjEquiv`, `continuous_toFun` is written as `Continuous.comp (continuous_apply ...) <| continuous_subtype_val`. This is slightly non-idiomatic compared to the common `.comp` method style used elsewhere in Mathlib for composing continuity proofs.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
def iInfKerProjEquiv {I J : Set ι} [DecidablePred fun i => i ∈ I] (hd : Disjoint I J)
    (hu : Set.univ ⊆ I ∪ J) :
    (⨅ i ∈ J, ker (proj i : (∀ i, φ i) →L[R] φ i) :
    Submodule R (∀ i, φ i)) ≃L[R] ∀ i : I, φ i where
  toLinearEquiv := LinearMap.iInfKerProjEquiv R φ hd hu
  continuous_toFun :=
    continuous_pi fun i => (continuous_apply (A := φ) i).comp continuous_subtype_val
  continuous_invFun :=
    Continuous.subtype_mk
      (continuous_pi fun i => by
        dsimp
        split_ifs <;> [apply continuous_apply; exact continuous_zero])
      _

candidates.suggested_fix: Replace the line with `continuous_pi fun i => (continuous_apply (A := φ) i).comp continuous_subtype_val` (verified to compile).
